title: Amazing football juggler – level 1
paragraphs: A man sets a new record. He is from Moscow. He gives a special performance.

He does three things at the same time. He stands on a big ball. He juggles with three footballs. He does “keepy uppies”. This means he moves a ball from foot to foot. The man does all of this for 14 seconds. He does 36 “keepy uppies”.
The man studied at a circus school. His mother enrolled him. He started to work when he was 15.
You can read the original story and watch the video in the Level 3 section.

words.d: to keep three things in the air with your hands or with your feet
